description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the PerformanceTrackerLogDao component of the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It tests methods such as retrieving logs by ID, by tracker ID, and counting logs by achievement rate.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for PerformanceTrackerLogDao, focusing on retrieving performance tracker logs and counting achievements.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a performance tracker log by its ID.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogsByTrackerId
methods.description: Tests retrieving logs filtered by tracker ID, including cases with logs, without logs, and non-existent IDs.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogsRateCount
methods.description: Tests counting positive and negative achievement logs for a specific tracker ID.
